Swiss Army Bench 0.0.34

- **Blazor is now the app's front end.** The app opens the Blazor pages. Every older address (a bookmark, the
  desktop app, a pushed table, an agent's window, the Canvas and Widgets windows) lands on its Blazor page.
- **The classic pages stay one more release as a fallback**, then go: Settings → Front end → Classic (the old
  pages), or `swissarmybench open --classic`.
- **Something missing pops up its install.** When a widget's Preview, the Canvas's widget previews, Play or Launch
  needs a package (Streamlit, for example), the install prompt opens by itself: Install now puts it into the open
  project's Python (or the app's own when no project is open), then the widget runs again and the previews redraw.
  Before, a red error sentence showed and the Canvas's widgets drew as empty boxes.
- **The widget library is a navigator by title.** One line per widget under plain headings; click one to see its
  description.
- **Panes you place.** On the Widgets page (Library, Properties) and the Canvas (Widgets, Properties), each pane can
  be hidden and moved to the left or right side (its "…" menu, or drag its header); two on one side stack one over
  the other. The layout is remembered. On the Canvas, Widgets now starts on the left and Properties on the right.
